Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Barfoot
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 01/24/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 92 (Act 2018-74) as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Surface Mining Commission until October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill does not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
